params.caption: 🕹️ Steam store pages will now show real Steam Deck frame rates Valve is adding average frame-rate data from players to store pages, shown next to the Deck verification badge once enough data is collected. The goal is a clearer picture, since some "Verified" games have not performed as well as players expected. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 22:07 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #SteamDeck #Valve #GamingNews
